items.t: Peloton stock rises on $300M share buyback authorization
items.sum: Investing.com -- Peloton Interactive Inc (NASDAQ:PTON) shares climbed 2.8% in after-hours trading Monday after the company announced its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $300 million of its Class A common stock.
